correctness.rationale: In the two-sided periodic language, avoiding the first three obstruction families exactly characterizes factors with cyclic consecutive run labels and full interior runs. Any extra finite-word MAW must be longer than (k-1)p+1; its occurring prefix and suffix have unique phase by distinct ordered transitions, forcing suffix/prefix boundary occurrences and border length m-2. Because P is unbordered and P^k has shortest period p, m=(k-1)p+2 and the unique endpoint factor follows. Direct independent literal-factor enumeration matched all predicted MAW sets for 500 small parameter cases covering 10,386 MAWs. The proof establishes unrestricted k rather than extrapolation.
